scope: NSE cash intraday, completed 5-minute candles; no overnight carry
option_research: Separate study blocked until exact dated contracts, signed premium/chain/master originals and current rights are qualified
dataset_freeze_rule: Before viewing any result bind exact original datasets, point-in-time universe and membership, exclusions, corporate-action treatment, session dates, source hashes, rights/trust policies, parameters and cost schedule in HistoricalEvidenceArchive. Unbound design cannot authorize evaluation.

sampling.universe: All instruments meeting a prospectively declared authorized data-coverage and liquidity policy; retain exclusions and delisted members where applicable. No selection using study returns.
sampling.short_coverage_policy: Block study; do not silently shrink windows
sampling.warmup: Prior completed bars only; at least 200 for a common four-strategy comparison plus every current-session bar from 09:15. Warm-up observations are excluded from evaluation metrics.
sampling.partition_rule: Distinct chronological full session dates, no random splitting, no undeclared intermediate sessions; no positions carried across folds
sampling.walk_forward: Fixed 21-session future test blocks within the sealed OOS interval; expanding past prefixes; parameters never retuned

comparisons.baseline: NO_TRADE_CASH: zero exposure, zero trading costs and zero trading P&L; excludes interest and inflation
comparisons.simple_existing_reference: strat_4_orb_filtered with unchanged parameters; this is an existing strategy comparator, not an independently proven benchmark
comparisons.cash_fill_policy: Existing NEXT_CANDLE_OPEN, STOP_LOSS_FIRST_CONSERVATIVE, TARGET_1 full exit, configured 15:20 square-off
comparisons.new_paper_continuation_policy: Separate versioned cohort; never pool its fills or metrics with historical NEXT_CANDLE_OPEN results
comparisons.fees: Freeze IndianCostModel schedule and dated documented applicability; current defaults are estimated, not current exchange certification
comparisons.spread_liquidity: Observed spread/depth only when qualified; absence is explicit and limits fill conclusions
comparisons.multiple_testing_family: Four fixed cash strategies; base 5 bps primary, 10 and 20 bps adverse-cost sensitivities; retain every result and failed variant
comparisons.primary_metric: Net expectancy per risk unit, with session-clustered uncertainty; requires future qualified observations and reviewed statistical implementation
comparisons.selection_bias: No best-of-run claims; report all variants, confidence intervals and multiple-testing treatment; no OOS tuning or recycling
comparisons.multiple_testing_method: Predeclared Holm family-wise adjustment across four primary strategy hypotheses; statistical tooling not implemented or accepted by this artifact
comparisons.regimes: Declare regime labels from past information before results; label unavailable when required index/sector observations are absent

promotion.to_oos_evidence_available: Qualified retained sources and current research rights; frozen dataset/config/source/partitions; complete reconciled OOS results and limitations independently reviewed. Evidence availability does not imply profitability.
promotion.to_paper_observation_in_progress: Separate approved live-observation path and new entry-policy cohort, with actual qualified observations; replay and synthetic tests cannot advance this state
promotion.to_paper_evidence_reviewed: Independent review of retained qualified paper events, reconciliation, sample precision, costs, drift, adverse regimes and predeclared risk limits; no minimum win rate by itself
promotion.economic_research_candidate: Positive lower simultaneous confidence bound on net expectancy versus no-trade after costs, robustness to adverse-cost scenarios, and drawdown within the prospectively approved account budget. Insufficient precision remains inconclusive, not a pass.
promotion.risk_budget: Bind the operator-approved existing account limits before dataset freeze; no new numeric drawdown limit is invented here

suspension: breach of predeclared account risk limits
retirement: Retain failed variants and evidence. Retire or revise only after recorded review of repeated independent failure or disproven hypothesis; a revision receives a new ID and fresh sealed data.
